concepts.name: faithful-inset
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, refinement of the attached exact app screenshot. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024, natural desktop ratio. Create realistic production-quality native Windows .NET MAUI UI for "AI Reset Radar" based closely on the attached Reset Horizon screenshot. Full app viewport, dark mode only, no device mockup. Preserve its charcoal #141519/#1B1C20, graphite #222329, lavender #B5A0F4 and purple #7169CA, subtle borders, Segoe typography, white and muted gray labels, header brand top left and Refresh and Settings top right, Reset Horizon title and upcoming-events area, Accounts area below, earned-reset summary upper right, and a small popup lower-right. This is iterative refinement, not a new product style.
MANDATORY USER FEEDBACK: remove entirely the redundant Used/Left column that was between the usage bar and reset block in the reference. Each account row now has THREE areas only: account identity at left, a substantially wider and TALLER usage bar in the middle, reset time at right. Bars must be 44-52 px tall and hold their labels INSIDE the bar itself, vertically centered: USED text on the filled left section, LEFT text on the unfilled right section. Absolutely no used/left labels or percentages above/below the bars or in a separate duplicate column. Filled length means USED throughout. Make in-bar text high contrast and legible on both segments, including narrow segments; use dark purple fill if necessary for white text. Keep account names and reset labels readable. Do not add dashboards, extra metrics, side navigation, charts, additional features, nested cards or decorative illustrations. Four quota rows: OpenAI Personal / Codex 5-hour, OpenAI Personal / Codex weekly, GitHub Copilot Work / AI credits monthly, OpenAI Work / Codex 5-hour.
Exact demo snapshot anchor: Sunday Oct 25, 2026, 9:46 AM CDT, America/Chicago. Row1 bar "38% used" / "62% left", reset "In 2h 14m" / "Today, 12:00 PM CDT". Row2 bar "74% used" / "26% left", reset "Tue, Oct 27" / "9:00 AM CDT". Row3 bar "8,200 used" / "1,800 left", total allowance 10,000 can be in account subtitle, reset "Sat, Oct 31" / "7:00 PM CDT"; omit UTC conversion text entirely. Row4 bar "19% used" / "81% left", reset "In 3h 44m" / "Today, 1:30 PM CDT".
Earned-reset summary: "2 Codex resets available" / "Earliest expires Oct 29 · 4 days left". Timeline has chronologically ordered milestones Today Oct25 / Tue Oct27 / Thu Oct29 expiry / Sat Oct31; do not place Oct29 after Oct31, do not label Oct31 next month. This can be an ordered event strip rather than time-proportional.
Popup "Codex weekly is running low" / "26% left · OpenAI / Personal", actions View account and Snooze. Keep it small and below/right of primary content so no row is hidden. Treat 26% and18% remaining as warning levels if using status color, never healthy green; lavender may remain neutral throughout. All values are illustrative. Body 14-16px minimum, generous spacing, clear alignment, very polished restrained native utility. No option numbers, no direction label written into the app. Specific variation follows: Direction "Faithful Inset": The smallest, most faithful refinement of the reference. Keep the original top timeline panel and four rounded horizontal row surfaces. Reclaim the removed duplicate column entirely for 620px-wide pill bars with about46px height, subtle inset depth, soft lavender USED fill, charcoal remainder. Used label left-aligned with16px inset, left label right-aligned with16px inset. Header and account icon sizes follow reference. Maintain a separate neat 240px reset block at right, with one thin divider before it. Calm and elegant, identical structural character to selected screenshot.
